question: Does one film-type Gaussian cloud scale fitted only from multi-aperture RMS granularity make the independent composite Table 25 MTF family more consistent with a shared nuisance response than no diffusion and a cyclic wrong-film scale?
evidence_role: development-only measured compatibility because every source table was observed during P4AT

fit.observations: RMS granularity at circular aperture diameters 13, 27 and 57 micrometres; missing cells remain missing
fit.noise_model: white density source filtered by one normalized Gaussian cloud PSF and the exact circular aperture MTF
fit.per_density_amplitude: closed-form log-domain nuisance fitted only after sigma proposal
fit.objective: mean squared log RMS residual across all available aperture cells

evaluation.candidate_residual: measured composite MTF divided by fitted film-type Gaussian MTF
evaluation.dispersion: mean across frequencies of median absolute log residual deviation from the frequency median
evaluation.shared_nuisance_assumption: x-ray source plus process plus scanner response is exposure-invariant only as a testable compatibility approximation

controls: reported 27 printed versus 26 prose series contradiction
forbidden: fit a separate MTF and RMS scale
change aperture model, bounds, optimizer, controls or gates after scoring
call a pass fresh confirmation, emulsion-only MTF, stock calibration or product evidence

branch_rule.pass: Retain the shared-scale mechanism as measured development compatibility and require a new rights-cleared material/process confirmation before profile use.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact Gaussian shared-scale measured family without rescue; retain P4AS synthetic mechanism only and continue a distinct physical leaf.

claim_ceiling: Development-only compatibility of a generic shared cloud scale with one public radiographic film report containing composite system MTF; no NPS curve samples, camera-film stock, scanner calibration or product claim.
